name: Seaca Packaging
old_description: Founded by a six-generation packaging company in 1991, SeaCa Packaging expanded the family legacy of reliable service, commitment to deliveries and customer focused approach by providing high quality graphic packaging to Central California.
about:
SeaCa Packaging operates from Dinuba, California, in the heart of the Central Valley. The company was established in 1991 by the owners of Seattle‑Tacoma Box Company, a family business founded in 1889 that had already passed through six generations. SeaCa was created to extend that legacy of reliable service and on‑time delivery to growers and packers in Central California.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures printed corrugated boxes, plastic corrugated (polypropylene) containers, and wooden packaging. It also provides value‑added services such as structural design and graphic printing. The operation serves agricultural, industrial, and seafood customers, though the facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Primary markets include the fruit, vegetable, and seafood sectors along the West Coast. SeaCa’s corrugated and plastic packaging is used for harvesting, shipping, and display of fresh produce, while its wooden crates and bins support heavier industrial and seafood applications.

SeaCa emphasizes its family heritage, a customer‑focused approach, and a commitment to sustainable packaging solutions. The company says its six‑generation experience allows it to deliver practical, innovative packaging that helps clients stand out in competitive markets.
